source_grounded_findings.finding: Commit 0fd27f explicitly deletes tools/frank_adaptive_vision.py and tools/frank_visual_pipeline.py and states they are replaced by tools/frank_eye.py while adding FrankEye as a DINOv2 INT8 ONNX unified vision module.

The historical Adaptive Visual Pipeline was adaptive routing, not demonstrated online personalization: Stage 1 fast detectors ran first; an EscalationEngine used analysis/user-question confidence and rules to decide whether Stage 2 Ollama VLM was needed. Text-heavy screenshots and text-labeled diagrams could bypass VLM with rule-assigned confidence.

The deleted Stage-1 visual pipeline is described as YOLO object detection + Tesseract OCR + scene heuristics on CPU, producing structured analysis for escalation. The source comment that about 90% of images do not need VLM is preserved as a source claim, not promoted to a measured result by this audit.

Frozen-head tools/frank_eye.py merges Digital Retina v8 CNN classification, DINOv2 scene analysis, GOLPU-derived visual feature analysis, Tesseract OCR and OpenCV face detection. It contains fixed Retina/DINO/GOLPU weight/library paths and explicitly labels the CNN classifier 'inference only'.

Within the audited old/new vision lineage there is no source-grounded evidence of the FRANK 0.1 required user-specific cyclic learner: no trusted GOLD/SILVER example admission, prototype/readout candidate update, shadow promotion, learner rollback/versioning, or calibrated familiarity/open-set state was established. Dynamic escalation confidence must not be relabeled as learned familiarity.

details: Retain the historical cheap-first/deep-on-uncertainty routing idea as lineage support for the current familiar-fast-path/deeper-Retina architecture.
Do not treat old EscalationEngine confidence as familiarity or authority; its rules were routing heuristics.

FrankEye's frozen reusable features/inference modules are compatible in principle with placing a prototype/tiny readout Micro Visual Classifier above reusable features, but this receipt does not prove which backbone wins.
The current owner-fixed MVC contract is a genuine additional learning-state requirement, not something already satisfied merely because historical code used the word adaptive.

dictionary_scope_boundary: A search for 'visual dictionary' at frozen head surfaced generic UI/tools references but no source-grounded historical visual familiarity dictionary mechanism was established in this lane. No dictionary implementation is claimed.
